008package convert;
009
010import java.nio.file.Path;
011import java.text.ParseException;
012import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
013import java.util.*;
014
015/**
016 * Specialized converter for the recordings table.
017 */
018public final class RecordingsConverter {
019
020    private final Path inputFile;
021    private final Path outputFile;
022
023    public RecordingsConverter(Path inputDir) {
024        this.inputFile = inputDir.resolve("All Recordings.csv");
025        this.outputFile = inputDir.resolve("Recordings.csv");
026    }
027
028    private static final List<String> HEADER = Arrays.asList(
029            "Experiment Name",
030            "Recording Name",
031            "Condition Number",
032            "Replicate Number",
033            "Probe Name",
034            "Probe Type",
035            "Cell Type",
036            "Adjuvant",
037            "Concentration",
038            "Process Flag",
039            "Threshold",
040            "Number of Spots",
041            "Number of Tracks",
042            "Number of Tracks in Background",
043            "Number of Squares in Background",
044            "Average Tracks in Background",
045            "Number of Spots in All Tracks",
046            "Number of Frames",
047            "Run Time",
048            "Time Stamp",
049            "Exclude",
050            "Tau",
051            "R Squared",
052            "Density",
053            "Min Required Density Ratio",
054            "Min Required R Squared",
055            "Max Allowable Variability",
056            "Neighbour Mode"
057    );
058
059    private static final Map<String,String> NAME_MAP = new HashMap<>();
060    static {
061        NAME_MAP.put("Experiment Name",               "Experiment Name");
062        NAME_MAP.put("Recording Name",                "Recording Name");
063        NAME_MAP.put("Condition Number",              "Condition Nr");
064        NAME_MAP.put("Replicate Number",              "Replicate Nr");
065        NAME_MAP.put("Probe Name",                    "Probe");
066        NAME_MAP.put("Probe Type",                    "Probe Type");
067        NAME_MAP.put("Cell Type",                     "Cell Type");
068        NAME_MAP.put("Adjuvant",                      "Adjuvant");
069        NAME_MAP.put("Concentration",                 "Concentration");
070        NAME_MAP.put("Process Flag",                  "Process");
071        NAME_MAP.put("Threshold",                     "Threshold");
072        NAME_MAP.put("Number of Spots",               "Nr Spots");
073        NAME_MAP.put("Number of Tracks",              "Nr Tracks");
074        NAME_MAP.put("Number of Frames",              "Recording Size");
075        NAME_MAP.put("Run Time",                      "Run Time");
076        NAME_MAP.put("Time Stamp",                    "Time Stamp");
077        NAME_MAP.put("Number of Spots in All Tracks", "Nr Spots in All Tracks");
078        NAME_MAP.put("Min Required R Squared",        "Min Required R Squared");
079        NAME_MAP.put("Min Required Density Ratio",    "Min Required Density Ratio");
080        NAME_MAP.put("Max Allowable Variability",     "Max Allowable Variability");
081        NAME_MAP.put("Exclude",                       "Exclude");
082        NAME_MAP.put("Neighbour Mode",                "Neighbour Mode");
083        NAME_MAP.put("Tau",                           "Tau");
084        NAME_MAP.put("Density",                       "Density");
085        NAME_MAP.put("R Squared",                     "R Squared");
086    }
087
088    private static final Map<String,Integer> INDEX_MAP = new HashMap<>();
089    static {
090        INDEX_MAP.put("Number of Tracks in Background", 15);
091    }
092
093    public List<Map<String,String>> convert(List<Map<String,String>> src) {
094
095        List<Map<String,String>> out = new ArrayList<>();
096
097        for (Map<String,String> inRow : src) {
098
099            String[] raw = toArray(inRow);
100
101            Map<String,String> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();
102
103            for (String newCol : HEADER) {
104
105                // 1. name-based
106                if (NAME_MAP.containsKey(newCol)) {
107
108                    String oldName = NAME_MAP.get(newCol);
109
110                    if (inRow.containsKey(oldName)) {
111                        String val = safe(inRow.get(oldName));
112
113                        // SPECIAL CASE: fix Time Stamp format
114                        if (newCol.equals("Time Stamp")) {
115                            val = fixTimestamp(val);
116                        }
117
118                        row.put(newCol, val);
119                        continue;
120                    }
121                }
122
123                // 2. index-based
124                if (INDEX_MAP.containsKey(newCol)) {
125                    int idx = INDEX_MAP.get(newCol) - 1;
126                    if (idx >= 0 && idx < raw.length) {
127                        row.put(newCol, safe(raw[idx]));
128                        continue;
129                    }
130                }
131
132                // 3. default
133                row.put(newCol, "0");
134            }
135
136            out.add(row);
137        }
138
139        return out;
140    }
141
142    private static String[] toArray(Map<String,String> row) {
143        return row.values().toArray(new String[row.size()]);
144    }
145
146    private static String safe(String s) {
147        return (s == null ? "" : s.trim());
148    }
149
150    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
151    // TIMESTAMP NORMALIZER: "Wed Sep 3 18:16:25 2025" → "2025-09-03T18:16:25"
152    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
153    private static final SimpleDateFormat OLD_FMT =
154            new SimpleDateFormat("EEE MMM d HH:mm:ss yyyy", Locale.ENGLISH);
155
156    private static final SimpleDateFormat ISO_FMT =
157            new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss");
158
159    private static String fixTimestamp(String v) {
160        if (v == null || v.trim().isEmpty()) return "";
161
162        try {
163            Date d = OLD_FMT.parse(v.trim());
164            return ISO_FMT.format(d);
165        } catch (ParseException e) {
166            return v;   // leave untouched if unparseable
167        }
168    }
169
170    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
171
172    public void run() throws Exception {
173        System.out.println("Reading:  " + inputFile);
174        List<Map<String,String>> src = CsvIO.readSimpleCsv(inputFile);
175
176        System.out.println("Converting Recordings...");
177        List<Map<String,String>> out = convert(src);
178
179        System.out.println("Writing:  " + outputFile);
180        CsvIO.writeSimpleCsv(outputFile, HEADER, out);
181
182        System.out.println("✔ Recordings conversion complete.");
183    }
184}
